Inside each we seed radically mismatched pairings of plants & fungi - rosemary & velvet moss, poppy seeds & bioluminescent slime fungus, dandelion spores & weeping willow root fragments.  Each jar is then suffixed with a single obsidian shard. Every seven days, performers "orchestrate" the jar – whispering ancient lullabies to it, dripping colored resin onto its surface like blood moon tears, sketching constellations inside it with liquid charcoal. The ritual isn’t about growth or harvest. It’s about embodying liminal spaces, forcing impossible symbologies to breathe into being. People obsessively collect discarded plastic jewels – bottle caps, sugar bombs, toy shards – pouring them blindfolded into specific coloured jars. EACH colour dictates THE TONES THAT EVOKE that memory. Emerald green = rain in childhood bedrooms. Rust orange=the taste of grandpa’s whiskey. Indigo = the scent of hospital linen. After six months, these ‘Chromatic Memories’ are plunged into hot wax. Layered over charred silk cloth, they become brutalist shrines. Then, beneath strobe light and field-recordings, we smash open the wax vessels – releasing rivers of pigment, sound triggers - fractured sonic palimpsestries of forgotten lives spilling from the jars like ecstatic ruins.

We find hundreds of bruised, shattered glass jars – broken only at key points, spines radiating outwards like bones. Into these spines – not soil but pigmented honey, dyed indigo, saffron, ochtar, echoing the colours of apocalypse-adjacent sunsets. Then, guerilla gardeners scatter handfuls of WILD SEEDS – wild orchids, toxic poppies, feather ferns - into the cracks around the jar totems overnight. They bloom violently against concrete. One year later, the sticky, poisoned honey attracts insects and birds – transforming grey urban pockets into shimmering riots of decay & defiant beauty. The jar totem becomes an altar, haunted by ghost blooms breathing mad alchemy.



4. **Breath Alchemist Jars** (Sonic Instrument Collage): For three weeks, participants steal breath exhaled during moments of intense emotion—fear, ecstasy, rage—and capture it in bespoke miniature blown glass jars. Each jar vibrates subtly with trapped kinetic energy.  These jars then are strung together spine-like across caves, forests, rooftop gardens - becoming part of a living sculpture called “Skin Song”. When triggered by touch - walking barefoot among the jars releases the bottled breaths - transforming into subsonic frequencies triggering primal rhythms within the audience, unlocking ancestral DNA.



5. // // Velvet Jar Oracle Deck -  (Immersive Storytelling & Shadow Play) Collect dozens of hand painted & stained VELVET JARs – each adorned with obsessive patterns obsessed with obsession. On day zero, burn incense & pour tarot cards INTO the velvet interiors. With candlelight suspended above, cast the first jar’s shadow – a potent stain blooming under skin. Each jar speaks a story based on the archetypes it contains & their saturated color - the wound screaming emerald, the rebellion pulsating crimson. Don’  shave the smoke & chant mantraic poetry –  “Seed Time.”  Seven nights, the tribes gather drinking black ink & brewing visions – finding futures buried deep within the shadows bleeding from the cracked lips of the jars.
